sloka: अस्मिन्नहनि यच्छ्रेयश्चिन्त्यतां तन्मया सह ।हितं चायतियुक्तं च प्रयतौ कर्तुमर्हथः ।। ७.८३.८ ॥
transliteration: asminnahani yacchreyaścintyatāṁ tanmayā saha ।hitaṁ cāyatiyuktaṁ ca prayatau kartumarhathaḥ ।। 7.83.8 ॥

translations.english: Let whatever is good and beneficial, leading to future prosperity, be thought about by me together with you on this day, and both of you ought to strive to accomplish it.
